case_name: Fact piece about a real thing
title: Meet the Real F-35A
tests: Tests whether a short factual aircraft film preserves the named variant's visible geometry and operating characteristics.

faults.what: The supplied speech transcript contains only the Italian phrase “Un saluto.” The required English explanation of one engine and conventional runway takeoff is absent.
The aircraft remains suspended sideways above the runway in every sampled frame, with its landing gear extended. No forward runway roll or conventional lift-off is shown.
The aircraft has distorted wing and rear-fuselage geometry rather than convincing real F-35A proportions, and no clearly recognizable single rear engine exhaust is visible.
Wing and rear-body shapes change between frames, undermining aircraft-design consistency.
Unrequested blocks of garbled white text appear at the left and lower left near the end, and the aircraft carries malformed lettering.

judge.summary: The widescreen clip presents the three correct labels, but shows a distorted aircraft suspended over a runway and lacks the requested takeoff sequence and English narration.

must_haves.item: The aircraft has the recognizable F-35 configuration: one rear engine exhaust, two outward-canted vertical tails and no canards.
must_haves.why: Paired tails are visible, but the distorted rear geometry does not show a recognizable single engine exhaust, and the overall aircraft is not a convincing real F-35A.

must_haves.item: The takeoff shows a forward runway roll and lift-off, not hovering or a vertical launch.
must_haves.why: All four samples show the aircraft already suspended above the runway, pointed across rather than along it; none shows a runway roll or conventional lift-off.

must_haves.item: The same aircraft design remains consistent between the runway and airborne views.
must_haves.why: There is no grounded runway view establishing the transition, and the wing and rear-fuselage geometry visibly changes across the airborne samples.

must_haves.item: All three requested labels appear exactly and are legible.
must_haves.why: The three main overlay labels are legible and match the requested wording, appearing in the requested order.

must_haves.item: Audible English narration correctly describes one engine and conventional runway takeoff without attributing F-35B hover capability to the F-35A.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcript reports only “Un saluto,” not English narration explaining either requested fact.
